title: A/R Collection lists each customer's lines oldest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has three past-due invoices dated on three different days.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Open customer X's group.
  4. Read the Date column top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • oldest date at the top, newest at the bottom.

Why this matters: Collectors chase the oldest debt first.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountReceivable/Collections/CollectionsItem.php:49-55. V1 code, quoted: `usort($items, static fn ($a, $b) => $a->getDate() <=> $b->getDate());`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-104) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
